block.thebetweenlands.gecko_cage.discove: Le gecko semble très calme et vous regarde avec des yeux pleins d'amour
Vous pouvez voir les muscles du gecko qui tremblent de manière incontrôlable
Le gecko mâche furieusement sa queue et regarde autour comme s'il était possédé
Le gecko salive, transpire et urine autour de sa cage
Vous pouvez entendre le ventre du gecko qui gronde et il semble faire beaucoup de rots
Le gecko marche autour comme un ivrogne et regarde autour d'une manière schizophrénique
Les écailles du gecko deviennent dures comme la pierre, il peut à peine bouger
Les écailles du gecko ont un éclat rouge et il respire une respiration chaude
Le gecko a un regard vide dans les yeux et ne semble répondre à rien
Les écailles du gecko semblent légèrement brillantes
Le gecko court frénétiquement dans des motifs sans sens
Les yeux du gecko s'illuminèrent et, pendant un instant, il sembla avoir conscience de lui-même...
Vous n'aviez jamais vu un gecko plus sain, il est plein d'énergie
Les écailles du gecko sont gonflées et sa tête a l'air... différente
Le gecko semble léger, et son souffle ressemble à un vent creux

<scale:0.75>The Basilisk Draught petrifies the motor cortex of the brain, causing one to be frozen in place. <nl>A combination of Azuwynn, Fergalaz, Dayuniis, Yihinren, Yunugaz, and Byariis aspects is required to make this draught. <nl>The more Azuwynn is used, the stronger are the draught’s effects. <scale:0.75>The Blindman’s Brew severely limits the functions of the eye, causing one to only be able to see a small distance in front of them and be unable to sprint. <nl>A combination of Freiwynn, Dayuniis, Ordaniis, Geoliirgaz, and Byariis aspects is required to make this brew. <nl>The more Freiwynn is used, the stronger are the brew's effects. <scale:0.8>The Brew of the Cat's Eye makes the eyes extremely sensitive to light, allowing one to see very well in the dark. <nl>A combination of Freiwynn, Dayuniis, Ordaniis, and Geoliirgaz aspects is required to make this brew. <nl>The more Freiwynn is used, the stronger are the brew's effects. The aspect that influences the digestive organs and immune system.<nl>Tier I aspect.
The aspect that has effect on the mind and the border between reality and imagination.<nl>Tier II aspect.

<scale:0.75>The Elixir of Decay increases vulnerability to the decaying aura of the Betweenlands, causing one to experience a quicker decline in physical and psychological health. <nl>A combination of Yeowynn, Ordaniis, Dayuniis, and Byariis aspects is required to make this elixir. <nl>The more Dayuniis is used, the stronger are the elixir’s effects. <scale:0.85>The Nimblefeet Elixir enhances muscle swiftness and nimbleness, increasing one's movement speed. <nl>A combination of Azuwynn, Ordaniis, and Yunugaz aspects is required to make this elixir. <nl>The more Yunugaz is used, the stronger are the elixir’s effects. The aspect that activates other aspects or enhances power in any form.<nl>Tier I aspect.

<scale:0.8>The Poisonsting Elixir contains the wrath of the sinister plants found in the Betweenlands, poisoning one instantly. <nl>A combination of Azuwynn, Yeowynn, Celawynn, and Byariis aspects is required to make this elixir. <nl>The more Yeowynn is used, the stronger are the elixir’s effects. <scale:0.75>The Elixir of Ripening reverses the effects of the decaying aura of the Betweenlands, restoring one's physical and psychological health over time. <nl>A combination of Yeowynn, Ordaniis, and Dayuniis aspects is required to make this elixir. <nl>The more Dayuniis is used, the stronger are the elixir’s effects. <scale:0.75>The Draught of Sagittarius contains the power of Sagittarius, allowing one to see exactly what path their arrow will take when fired from a bow. <nl>A combination of Freiwynn, Dayuniis, Byariis, Ordaniis, and Armaniis aspects is required to make this draught. <nl>The more Freiwynn is used, the stronger are the draught's effects. Sap Spit is a tacky secretion produced by Spirit Trees. It seems to have regenerative properties.
